title: Appeal an Infraction

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Greetings, RemakePVP.

I am very glad to see that you take full responsability for your acts and face the consequences accordingly, but unfortunately for you, we do not make any exceptions in here. You've confessed to hacking and you'll have to face a penalty like everyone else. Submit a new appeal six months after your punishment was issued for positive results.

Sincerely,
- timaeusTestified | Senior Moderator
